name: CMK Corporation
summary: CMK Corporation develops, produces, and markets various printed circuit boards in Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automotive PCB; high heat dissipation or high current copper base and composite metal PCBs; semi-flex and rigid-flex PCB series; high frequency correspondence PCBs; high-multi-layer-PCB; PPBU series; through-hole PCBs; and double-sided multilayer PCBs. The company's products are used in automotive, medical, telecommunications, and aerospace industries. CMK Corporation has a strategic alliance with Guangdong Ellington Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
